name: Metaphyseal Chondrodysplasia, Kaitila Type

criteria.description: Radiographic evidence of metaphyseal irregularities and flaring
Disproportionate short stature with short limbs apparent in early childhood
Identification of pathogenic variants in the gene associated with Kaitila type metaphyseal chondrodysplasia
Normal cognitive development despite skeletal abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic metaphyseal abnormalities on imaging combined with clinical features of disproportionate short stature; genetic testing supportive but not mandatory
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical and radiological; genetic confirmation aids in definitive diagnosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Metaphyseal irregularities with flaring and cupping
Disproportionate short stature with short limbs
searchTerms: short stature with disproportionately short limbs
disproportionate short height due to limb shortening

pathognomonic.symptomName: Normal cognitive development despite skeletal deformities
searchTerms: typical cognitive development with skeletal deformities
no learning issues despite bone abnormalities

occasional.notes: Subtle features such as mild midface hypoplasia

rare.symptomName: Occasional respiratory infections due to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: sometimes lung infections from chest shape
occasional breathing infections due to rib cage

imaging: Radiographs showing metaphyseal flaring, cupping, and irregularities
Delayed bone age on hand-wrist X-rays
Mild thoracic cage deformities on chest X-ray
genetic: Pathogenic variants in gene(s) associated with metaphyseal chondrodysplasia Kaitila type (exact gene not fully established)
other: Normal cognitive and neurological examination findings

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of short stature with more pronounced bone deformities
Different radiographic pattern and genetic cause

redFlags: Progressive worsening of skeletal deformities beyond early childhood
Severe respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage abnormalities
references: Kaitila I, et al. Metaphyseal chondrodysplasia, Kaitila type: clinical and radiological features. Am J Med Genet. 1993.
Orphanet: Metaphyseal chondrodysplasia, Kaitila type. ORPHA:166038
Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
